Default.note: Two real fields, uppercase token labels above each control, placeholder in muted, one calm helper line. Square corners, line-grey borders, no shadow.

Filled.note: defaultValue renders as foreground text at full contrast; label/control/value hierarchy reads cleanly.

Types.note: tel, date and number all render their native affordances inside the system's border; the date picker glyph sits flush right without breaking the square frame.

Invalid.note: aria-invalid gives a destructive border on both the filled and the empty case, each with a destructive message under it. Colour stays inside the ~2% cap.

Disabled.note: Both disabled fields drop to 50% — value and placeholder variants — and the helper line explains why rather than leaving it implied.
